candidate: Transfer the ability to construct identifying experiments across changed worlds.
claim_status: Unproven; general experimental preparation is already an existing planning capability.
environment: Native SymbolicAlchemy; one stone and four consumable potions per trial; four trials per episode.
researcher_supplied: Known identity perceptual maps; native random-bottleneck graph prior. No source-trained constructor or hidden true graph supplied to policies.
baselines: Upstream within-trial exhaustive ideal explorer with native belief updates
decision: Retain the native exact within-trial planner as a required baseline. Retire generic preparation as the claimed novelty. Do not scale this fixed known-map, one-stone, four-potion family absent a distinct source-dependent operation and a measured benefit.
next_requirement: Specify a concrete learned transformation of source experience that changes recipient experiment construction, then compare with equal-information target-only planning, ordinary policy/skill transfer and learned/amortized experimental design. DEL-style prerequisite learning and renamed macro-actions do not suffice. The present runs do not falsify all cross-world experimental transfer.
limitations: Selected diagnostic checkpoints, not independent held-out tasks.
Known perceptual mappings simplify the full Alchemy benchmark.
The native explorer optimizes expected remaining world count within the current trial, not total multi-trial reward.
Planning timings isolate upstream search, so they are not end-to-end inference costs or a fair cost comparison to a learned method.
No novel constructor or source-transfer arm was evaluated.

setup.compatibility: dm-env-rpc pinned to 1.1.6 and numpy to 1.23.5; upstream planner and transitions unchanged. Initial wrapper v0 failed before the first native step; v1 corrected its optional argument forwarding.

closest_priors.title: Alchemy ideal observer
closest_priors.finding: Native search explicitly recurses through deterministic state-changing actions before later information gains and offers an objective minimizing remaining world states.

closest_priors.title: Learning Game Strategies by Experimentation
closest_priors.finding: DEL learns prerequisites and contextual conditions for experiments, postpones ambiguous tests, and lifts traces into reusable strategic plans. This is a direct prior against generic experiment-preparation novelty.

headline_cn: Alchemy原生规划器已能构造零即时信息的准备动作；三个相同历史对照中，候选规律数由12／12／8降至6／8／1，单步策略均停留原处。该能力尚不能作为新贡献。
report_note_cn: 完成Alchemy原生符号环境的8种子、每种子两种策略、每次4试次对照，共194个原生动作。已知感知映射，未知瓶颈图，使用原生图先验与信念更新。原生ideal explorer对当前试次完整搜索，跨试次只保留后验，不是整个四试次episode的全局最优规划。记录到6次零即时信息收益的准备动作，其中3次的全部可选动作均无单步信息收益。对这3个探索后选出的状态重放相同历史：单步策略保留12／12／8个候选，原生规划分别降至6／8／1；重放及分支另用70个动作，其中52个重放、18个继续执行。它们不是3个独立留出任务。已有搜索在每个四试次episode累计约3.6–24.6毫秒，未包含预计算加载与诊断开销。当前没有训练或评估迁移方法，也没有证明源经验优势。停止把一般实验准备或未测量的计算节省作为新意；不扩大该小型对照。
